# requirements.lock.txt — exact pinned versions for reproducing the
# production KinSim environment.
#
# This file is intentionally empty in the repository. The authoritative
# pin set lives on the production cluster (conda env `kinsim_env`) and
# must be regenerated from there to capture the exact PyTorch wheel,
# pysam, and TensorBoard versions used to train the current checkpoint:
#
#     ssh <cluster>
#     conda activate kinsim_env
#     pip freeze > requirements.lock.txt
#
# Reproducing the environment locally from the regenerated file:
#
#     python -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate
#     pip install -r requirements.lock.txt
#     pip install -e .
#
# Notes:
#   - The PyTorch wheel index depends on the local CUDA stack. The
#     cluster uses CUDA 12.1 wheels; for CPU-only reproduction, drop
#     any `+cu121` suffix and pin from
#     https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu.
#   - EMBOSS fuzznuc (used by `kinsim_NN.utils.motifs`) is a system
#     binary and is not pip-installable. Cluster install: EMBOSS 6.6.0.
#   - The PacBio binaries (`ccs-kinetics-bystrandify`, `pbmm2`,
#     `ipdSummary`, `pbmotifmaker`) ship with SMRT-Link. The cluster
#     uses two SMRT-Link installs: the Apptainer image
#     `pacbio-smrt-tools-25.3.sif` (default for prep, alignment, jasmine
#     bystrandify wrapper) and L. Falquet's SMRT-Link 25.1 install for
#     `ipdSummary` and `pbmotifmaker` to match his reference detection
#     rates on the production corpus.
#   - `jasmine` and `modkit` are invoked from the conda environment;
#     their exact versions should be captured by `pip freeze` and
#     `jasmine --version` / `modkit --version`.
